correctness.rationale: For coprime a,b>=2, modular reduction of ax+by=mab forces (x,y)=(bj,a(m-j)), 0<=j<=m; endpoints are nonprimitive. The local obstruction p|gcd(bj,a(m-j)) separates primes dividing a, dividing b, or neither. Checking indices j for m=2,...,15 as in RESULT.md gives universal representability. For m=16 every even j is obstructed; j=1,15 force 3 and 5 on opposite factors, and j=3,9,11 force 13 and 7 on one factor and 11 on the other. Thus failure iff (55|a and 273|b) or reversed. Independently enumerated all 3^6 disjoint statuses of p=2,3,5,7,11,13, confirming each of 729 statuses at 2..16 and the exact m=16 failure locus; finite prime-state verification is exhaustive here because j,m-j<=15.
